title: The Future
question: Does what Madam Bellinsky said come true?

meanings.usage: 指给人算命或预测未来的人
露天的商品交易或娱乐活动集会
指家庭成员或亲戚关系
算命者用来预测未来的工具
用帆布等搭建的临时住所
形容急切或缺乏耐心的样子
表示快速移动或匆忙做事
指把自己藏起来不让别人发现
指快速移动或匆忙行动

examples.en: I decided to visit a fortune-teller.
examples.zh: 我决定去拜访一位算命师。

examples.en: She looked into a crystal ball.
examples.zh: 她向水晶球里面看。

examples.en: As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky.
examples.zh: 我一走出帐篷，就把贝琳斯基夫人忘得一干二净。

examples.en: I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky.
examples.zh: 我把贝琳斯基夫人忘得一干二净。

examples.en: My wife hurried towards me.
examples.zh: 我妻子匆忙向我走来。

examples.en: Your sister will be here in less than an hour.
examples.zh: 你姐姐不到一个小时就到了。

examples.en: She will lead you away from this place.
examples.zh: 她会把你从这个地方带走。

examples.en: She intends to stay for a few days.

sentences.en: At a village fair, I decided to visit a fortune-teller called Madam Bellinsky.
sentences.zh: 在一个乡村集市上，我决定去拜访一位名叫贝林斯基夫人的算命师。

sentences.en: I went into her tent and she told me to sit down.
sentences.zh: 我走进她的帐篷，她叫我坐下。

sentences.en: After I had given her some money, she looked into a crystal ball and said:
sentences.zh: 我给了她一些钱后，她看着水晶球说：

sentences.en: 'A relation of yours is coming to see you.
She will be arriving this evening and intends to stay for a few days.
sentences.zh: 她今晚会到，打算住几天。

sentences.en: The moment you leave this tent, you will get a big surprise.
sentences.zh: 你一离开这个帐篷，就会有一个大惊喜。

sentences.en: A woman you know well will rush towards you.
sentences.zh: 一位你很熟悉的女人会向你跑来。

sentences.en: She will speak to you and then she will lead you away from this place. That is all.'
sentences.zh: 她会和你说话，然后带你离开这个地方。就这些了。”

sentences.en: As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky because my wife hurried towards me.
sentences.zh: 我一出去，就完全把贝林斯基夫人忘在脑后了，因为我妻子匆匆向我走来。

sentences.en: 'Where have you been hiding?' she asked impatiently.
sentences.zh: “你躲到哪里去了？”她不耐烦地问。

sentences.en: 'Your sister will be here in less than an hour and we must be at the station to meet her. We are late already.'
sentences.zh: “你妹妹不到一小时就要到了，我们必须去车站接她。我们已经迟到了。”

sentences.en: As she walked away, I followed her out of the fair.
sentences.zh: 她走开时，我跟着她离开了集市。

grammar.title: 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)
grammar.definition: 表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作，强调动作的先后顺序
grammar.structure: 主语 + had + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于描述两个过去的动作，先发生的动作用过去完成时，后发生的动作用一般过去时

examples.en: After I had given her some money, she looked into a crystal ball.
examples.zh: 我给她一些钱之后，她看向水晶球。

examples.en: After she had finished her work, she went home.
examples.zh: 她完成工作后回家了。

grammar.title: be going to 表示意图 (Future Intention)
grammar.definition: 表示已经计划好或决定好的将来意图
grammar.structure: 主语 + be going to + 动词原形
grammar.usage: 用于表达主语已经决定要做的事情，带有计划性

examples.en: She intends to stay for a few days.
examples.zh: 她打算待几天。

examples.en: We are going to be at the station.
examples.zh: 我们打算在车站。

grammar.title: 时间状语从句 (Time Clause)
grammar.definition: 用连词引导的状语从句，说明动作发生的时间
grammar.structure: 连词 + 主语 + 动词
grammar.usage: as soon as, the moment, after, before 等引导时间状语从句，主句用一般将来时，从句用一般现在时

examples.en: The moment you leave this tent, you will get a big surprise.
examples.zh: 你一离开这个帐篷，你就会得到一个大惊喜。

examples.en: As soon as I went outside, I forgot all about Madam Bellinsky.
examples.zh: 我一走出帐篷，就把贝琳斯基夫人忘得一干二净。
